newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank leaves repo rate flat at 4.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank leaves repo rate flat at 4.10 pct.

text.p: The Swedish central bank, the Riksbank, set a one week repurchase operation at an unchanged fixed rate of 4.10 percent on Tuesday as expected by the market.
The operation will run from July 16 to July 23 with all bids to be submitted by 0800 GMT on July 15.
The repo rate is the bank's key tool for controlling money market liquidity.
The repo rate has been unchanged since December 17, 1996, and many analysts do not expect a change until early 1998 when they see the Riksbank raising the rate.
The central bank's other key rates, the deposit and lending rates, stand at 3.75 percent and 5.25 percent respectively.
